answer_1.quote: We evaluate models on a test suite of 10 downstream tasks. For generation, we use Trivi-aQA , NaturalQuestions (NQ; , WebQuestions (WQ; , SQuAD 2.0 , and LAMBADA , covering question answering, reading comprehension and word prediction tasks. For ranking (multiplechoice question) tasks, we use COPA , PIQA , WiC (Pilehvar and Camacho-Collados, 2019), WinoGrande , and HellaSwag  spanning across question answering and commonsense reasoning.
models: Transformer decoder-only language models with 70M, 150M, 280M, 510M, 1B, and 10B parameters
answer_1.outputs: The models generate answers to questions and complete sequences in zero-shot, one-shot, and five-shot settings, with evaluation based on exact match accuracy for generation tasks and standard accuracy for ranking tasks.

answer_2.quote: We prepare all the above tasks in 0-, 1-, and 5-shot formats, and report exact match (EM) accuracies for generation tasks and standard accuracies for ranking tasks.
